emergency_guidance: During clinic hours, call our emergency line: +91 00000 20911 (fictional). Do not wait for a reply in the chat.
Go to Example 24-Hour Animal Hospital (fictional), 12 Sample Ring Road, open day and night, phone +91 00000 20999 (fictional). Call them while you are on the way.
If you know what your pet ate, bring the packaging or a photo of it.
Do not give your pet any medicine or home remedy unless a vet tells you to.
